observed.subject_structure_and_limb_count: unknown; infer from the input, never force biped anatomy

eye_surface_and_light_response.eye_emission_or_reflection: unknown; do not confuse glowing eyes with reflective catchlights
eye_surface_and_light_response.visibility_and_lighting_rule: retain the observed treatment on visible eye surfaces; do not force reflections on occluded, closed or absent eyes

framing_lock.anchor_kind: unknown: e.g. verified_ground_contact, body_center, user_defined, or unknown

review_heuristics.role: configurable review triggers, not universal pass/fail thresholds

feature_lock_fields.id: stable ID for an actually observed identifying feature
feature_lock_fields.body_part_surface_and_anatomical_side: physical attachment, not fixed screen side
feature_lock_fields.shape_count_and_neighbors: observed topology and relative feature relationships
feature_lock_fields.expected_visibility_by_direction: visible, partial, hidden or unknown for S/SW/W/NW/N/NE/E/SE
feature_lock_fields.importance: critical identifying feature or minor texture detail

source_artifact_review.note: Visual semantic review required; numeric scripts do not set this status.
